name: seis-doc-indexer
description: Deterministic local full-text index for bounded Markdown and text documents.

interface.shortDescription: Search bounded local documents without creating an index file.
interface.longDescription: A read-only SEIS knowledge foundation plugin that scans bounded Markdown and text files, returns matching document metadata and snippets, and never writes an index or sends content to a remote service.
